name: singlet_neighbors_edge_weighting_adaptive_kernel
title: Weight kNN graph edges with adaptive kernels
description: Converts the stored kNN graph into a symmetric edge-weight matrix (connectivities) with one of four weightings: umap, the default fuzzy simplicial set with per-cell calibrated scales; gauss_adaptive; jaccard, shared-neighbour overlap with pruning; or perplexity, t-SNE-style calibrated affinities. It reads obsp/<key>_distances written by neighbors.approximate_knn_search and writes obsp/<key>_connectivities, optionally a row-stochastic transition matrix, and per-cell scales. Do not use it to build the neighbour lists, choose the neighbour count, choose the clustering resolution or score results against labels; it needs no labels.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

weighting.description: Edge-weight family computed from the kNN lists; umap is the default, jaccard gives scale-free shared-neighbour weights.

n_neighbors.description: Neighbour count k, Scanpy convention (the cell counts). Must not exceed the stored kNN list length plus one.

symmetrisation.description: native uses the method's own rule (umap: fuzzy_union; gauss_adaptive: copy_union; perplexity: average); jaccard is already symmetric.

row_normalise.description: Also write obsp/<key>_transitions, the row-stochastic Markov matrix for diffusion or pseudotime.

key.description: Stem for the written members: obsp/<key>_connectivities, obs/<key>_scale and uns/<key>.

umap.description: Options for weighting umap; ignored by other methods.

bandwidth.description: Target scale b in the calibration sum equal to b times log2 k.

local_connectivity.description: Number of nearest non-zero neighbours assumed connected; sets rho_i.

min_sigma_scale.description: Floor for sigma_i as a fraction of the mean kNN distance.

jaccard.description: Options for weighting jaccard; ignored by other methods.

prune.description: Edges with Jaccard weight below this value are dropped (Seurat default 1/15).

perplexity.description: Options for weighting perplexity; ignored by other methods.

target.description: Target perplexity; null uses (n_neighbors-1)/3. Must lie in (1, n_neighbors-1).

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written; the transition matrix only when row_normalise is true. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: n_cells, n_edges, mean_degree, isolated_cells, weighting, symmetrisation and scale_quantiles. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
